name: dd2875
description: DD Form 2875, System Authorization Access Request (SAAR).

fields.name: classification_page_1_bottom
fields.title: Classification (page 1, bottom)
fields.description: Repeats the classification marking at the foot of page 1.

fields.name: classification
fields.title: Classification
fields.description: The classification the filled form is marked with. The form marks it at the top and bottom of pages 1 and 2; this quill fills the top of page 1.

fields.name: type_of_request
fields.title: Type of request
fields.description: Whether the request opens an account, changes one, or closes one.

fields.name: user_id
fields.title: User ID
fields.description: The user ID the account has, or is to have. Leave it blank on an initial request when the system assigns one.

fields.name: request_date
fields.title: Date (YYYYMMDD)
fields.description: The date of the request, as YYYYMMDD.

fields.name: system_name
fields.title: System name (platform or applications)
fields.description: The system, platform or application the request is for.

fields.name: location
fields.title: Location (physical location of system)
fields.description: Where the system is physically located.

fields.name: name
fields.title: 1. Name (last, first, middle initial)
fields.description: The user's last name, first name and middle initial.

fields.name: organization
fields.title: 2. Organization
fields.description: The user's current organization (e.g. DISA, SDI, DoD and government agency or commercial firm).

fields.name: office_symbol_department
fields.title: 3. Office symbol/department
fields.description: The office symbol within the user's current organization.

fields.name: phone
fields.title: 4. Phone (DSN or commercial)
fields.description: The user's DSN number, or a commercial number when the user has no DSN.

fields.name: official_email_address
fields.title: 5. Official e-mail address
fields.description: The user's official e-mail address.

fields.name: job_title_and_grade_rank
fields.title: 6. Job title and grade/rank
fields.description: The user's job title and civilian grade or military rank, or "CTR" for a contractor.

fields.name: official_mailing_address
fields.title: 7. Official mailing address
fields.description: The user's official mailing address, one line per line of the address.
fields.example:
123 XS/SCX, 100 Example Ave
Notional AFB, CO 80000

fields.name: citizenship_us
fields.title: 8. Citizenship: US
fields.description: Checked when the user is a US citizen.

fields.name: citizenship_fn
fields.title: 8. Citizenship: FN
fields.description: Checked when the user is a foreign national.

fields.name: citizenship_other
fields.title: 8. Citizenship: Other
fields.description: Checked when the user's citizenship is neither US nor foreign national.

fields.name: designation_of_person_military
fields.title: 9. Designation of person: Military
fields.description: Checked when the user is a service member.

fields.name: designation_of_person_civilian
fields.title: 9. Designation of person: Civilian
fields.description: Checked when the user is a government civilian employee.

fields.name: designation_of_person_contractor
fields.title: 9. Designation of person: Contractor
fields.description: Checked when the user is a contractor.

fields.name: completed_annual_cyber_awareness_training
fields.title: 10. I have completed the Annual Cyber Awareness Training
fields.description: Checked when the user has completed the Annual Cyber Awareness Training.

fields.name: annual_cyber_awareness_training_date
fields.title: 10. Date (YYYYMMDD)
fields.description: The date the user completed the Annual Cyber Awareness Training, as YYYYMMDD.

fields.name: user_signature_date
fields.title: 12. Date (YYYYMMDD)
fields.description: The date the user signs the form, as YYYYMMDD.

fields.name: justification_for_access
fields.title: 13. Justification for access
fields.description: A brief statement of why the user needs the user ID, or the change to it.
fields.example: Needs access to the Notional Training Portal to schedule and record unit training.

fields.name: type_of_access_authorized
fields.title: 14. Type of access requested: Authorized
fields.description: Checked for normal access.

fields.name: type_of_access_privileged
fields.title: 14. Type of access requested: Privileged
fields.description: Checked for access that can amend or change the system's configuration, parameters or settings.

fields.name: access_to_unclassified
fields.title: 15. User requires access to: Unclassified
fields.description: Checked when the user needs access to unclassified information.

fields.name: access_to_classified
fields.title: 15. User requires access to: Classified
fields.description: Checked when the user needs access to classified information. Name the category beside it.

fields.name: classified_category
fields.title: 15. Classified (specify category)
fields.description: The classified category the user needs access to.

fields.name: access_to_other
fields.title: 15. User requires access to: Other
fields.description: Checked when the user needs access to something other than unclassified or classified information. Say what beside it.

fields.name: other_access
fields.title: 15. Other
fields.description: What the user needs access to, when it is neither unclassified nor classified information.

fields.name: verification_of_need_to_know
fields.title: 16. Verification of need to know: I certify that this user requires access as requested
fields.description: Checked when the supervisor or sponsor certifies the user requires the access requested.

fields.name: access_expiration_date
fields.title: 16a. Access expiration date
fields.description: The date the access expires, when it is less than a year away. A contractor gives the company name, contract number and the contract's expiration date, continuing in block 21 if needed.

fields.name: supervisor_name
fields.title: 17. Supervisor's name (print name)
fields.description: The printed name of the supervisor or representative who verifies the information above.

fields.name: supervisor_email_address
fields.title: 17a. Supervisor's email address
fields.description: The supervisor's e-mail address.

fields.name: supervisor_phone_number
fields.title: 17b. Phone number
fields.description: The supervisor's phone number.

fields.name: supervisor_organization_department
fields.title: 17c. Supervisor's organization/department
fields.description: The supervisor's organization and department.

fields.name: supervisor_signature_date
fields.title: 17e. Date (YYYYMMDD)
fields.description: The date the supervisor signs the form, as YYYYMMDD.

fields.name: information_owner_opr_phone_number
fields.title: 18. Information owner/OPR phone number
fields.description: The functional appointee's phone number.

fields.name: information_owner_opr_signature_date
fields.title: 18b. Date (YYYYMMDD)
fields.description: The date the functional appointee signs the form, as YYYYMMDD.

fields.name: isso_organization_department
fields.title: 19. ISSO organization/department
fields.description: The ISSO's organization and department.

fields.name: isso_phone_number
fields.title: 19a. Phone number
fields.description: The ISSO's phone number.

fields.name: isso_signature_date
fields.title: 19c. Date (YYYYMMDD)
fields.description: The date the ISSO or appointee signs the form, as YYYYMMDD.

fields.name: user_signature
fields.title: 11. User signature
fields.description: The user signs, accepting responsibility and accountability for their password and access to the system.

fields.name: supervisor_signature
fields.title: 17d. Supervisor signature
fields.description: The supervisor or the endorser's representative signs.

fields.name: information_owner_opr_signature
fields.title: 18a. Information owner/OPR signature
fields.description: The information owner, or the functional appointee of the office approving access, signs.

fields.name: isso_or_appointee_signature
fields.title: 19b. ISSO or appointee signature
fields.description: The ISSO, or the appointee of the office approving access, signs.

fields.name: classification_page_2_bottom
fields.title: Classification (page 2, bottom)
fields.description: Repeats the classification marking at the foot of page 2.

fields.name: classification_page_2_top
fields.title: Classification (page 2, top)
fields.description: Repeats the classification marking at the top of page 2.

fields.name: name_page_2
fields.title: 20. Name (last, first, middle initial)
fields.description: Repeats the user's name from block 1 at the top of page 2.

fields.name: optional_information
fields.title: 21. Optional information
fields.description: Anything more the request needs, such as a contractor's details continued from block 16a.
fields.example: Contract continued from block 16a: Notional Systems Inc., contract EXAMPLE-0000-0000, expires 20261231.

fields.name: type_of_investigation
fields.title: 22. Type of investigation
fields.description: The user's last type of background investigation (i.e. Tier 3, Tier 5).

fields.name: investigation_date
fields.title: 22a. Investigation date (YYYYMMDD)
fields.description: The date of the user's last investigation, as YYYYMMDD.

fields.name: continuous_vetting_enrollment_date
fields.title: 22b. Continuous vetting (CV) enrollment date (YYYYMMDD)
fields.description: The date the user enrolled in continuous vetting, as YYYYMMDD. Leave it blank when the user is not enrolled.

fields.name: access_level
fields.title: 22c. Access level
fields.description: The access level the sponsoring agency or service grants the user (i.e. Secret, Top Secret).

fields.name: verified_by
fields.title: 23. Verified by (printed name)
fields.description: The printed name of the security manager or representative who verifies the clearance and investigation.

fields.name: security_manager_phone_number
fields.title: 24. Phone number
fields.description: The security manager's phone number.

fields.name: verification_date
fields.title: 26. Verification date (YYYYMMDD)
fields.description: The date the security manager verified the background investigation and clearance, as YYYYMMDD.

fields.name: system_title
fields.title: Title (system line)
fields.description: The title of the system account, on Part IV's system line.

fields.name: system
fields.title: System
fields.description: The system the user is given access to.

fields.name: system_account_code
fields.title: Account code (system line)
fields.description: The account code for the system line.

fields.name: domain_title
fields.title: Title (domain line)
fields.description: The title of the domain account, on Part IV's domain line.

fields.name: domain
fields.title: Domain
fields.description: The domain the user is given access to.

fields.name: domain_account_code
fields.title: Account code (domain line)
fields.description: The account code for the domain line.

fields.name: server_title
fields.title: Title (server line)
fields.description: The title of the server account, on Part IV's server line.

fields.name: server
fields.title: Server
fields.description: The server the user is given access to.

fields.name: server_account_code
fields.title: Account code (server line)
fields.description: The account code for the server line.

fields.name: application_title
fields.title: Title (application line)
fields.description: The title of the application account, on Part IV's application line.

fields.name: application
fields.title: Application
fields.description: The application the user is given access to.

fields.name: application_account_code
fields.title: Account code (application line)
fields.description: The account code for the application line.

fields.name: files_title
fields.title: Title (files line)
fields.description: The title of the files account, on Part IV's files line.

fields.name: files
fields.title: Files
fields.description: The files the user is given access to.

fields.name: files_account_code
fields.title: Account code (files line)
fields.description: The account code for the files line.

fields.name: datasets_title
fields.title: Title (datasets line)
fields.description: The title of the datasets account, on Part IV's datasets line.

fields.name: datasets
fields.title: Datasets
fields.description: The datasets the user is given access to.

fields.name: datasets_account_code
fields.title: Account code (datasets line)
fields.description: The account code for the datasets line.

fields.name: date_processed
fields.title: Date processed (YYYYMMDD)
fields.description: The date the account information was processed, as YYYYMMDD.

fields.name: processed_by
fields.title: Processed by (print name and sign)
fields.description: The printed name of whoever processed the account information.

fields.name: processed_by_signature_date
fields.title: Processed by: Date (YYYYMMDD)
fields.description: The date whoever processed the account information signs, as YYYYMMDD.

fields.name: date_revalidated
fields.title: Date revalidated (YYYYMMDD)
fields.description: The date the account information was revalidated, as YYYYMMDD.

fields.name: revalidated_by
fields.title: Revalidated by (print name and sign)
fields.description: The printed name of whoever revalidated the account information.

fields.name: revalidated_by_signature_date
fields.title: Revalidated by: Date (YYYYMMDD)
fields.description: The date whoever revalidated the account information signs, as YYYYMMDD.

fields.name: security_manager_signature
fields.title: 25. Security manager signature
fields.description: The security manager or designated representative signs that the clearance and investigation are verified.

fields.name: processed_by_signature
fields.title: Processed by: Signature
fields.description: Whoever processed the account information signs.

fields.name: revalidated_by_signature
fields.title: Revalidated by: Signature
fields.description: Whoever revalidated the account information signs.
